heroSubtitle: Every role shows the full job description, how long the process usually takes from applying to starting, and a direct way to apply. We add new roles as employers send them to us.
emptyText: Tell us the kind of work you want and where you are now, and we will contact you when a matching role comes in.
howIntro: The processing time on each role is the typical time from your application to your first day, including the visa stage. It is an estimate, not a guarantee: it depends on the country, the employer, the visa authorities and how quickly your documents are ready.

steps.title: Send your application
steps.text: Use the apply button on the role. Attach your CV and tell us where you are based now.

steps.title: Eligibility check
steps.text: We go through the employer and visa requirements with you, so there are no surprises later.

steps.title: Offer, visa and start date
steps.text: We guide you from the interview to your visa and your first day in the new role.

contactText: Tell us the kind of work you want and where you are now. We will contact you when a matching role comes in.
seoDescription: Current job opportunities abroad with visa sponsorship, from Hubble Bubble. Each role shows the full job description, salary, the expected processing time and how to apply.
